is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus (page 4, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west), Vgsc L1014S (kdr-east), and Ace-1 G119S (page 4, Detection of insecticide resistance mutations).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for L1014F, L1014S, and G119S across different categories (page 6).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Simiw, Ghana (page 2, Study site).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted in 2021 (page 2, Methodology).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Simiw, Central Region, Ghana (page 2, Study site).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: All collections were conducted in 2021 (page 2, Methodology).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection in Simiw in 2021.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the biting behavior and insecticide resistance of Anopheles mosquitoes in Simiw, Ghana, in 2021. It reports high frequencies of the L1014F mutation and moderate frequencies of the G119S mutation in An. gambiae s.l. populations.
